Let \(p=2027\). We work modulo \(p\).

For \(k>\frac{p-1}{2}\), the binomial coefficient \(\binom{2k}{k}\) is divisible by \(p\), so only \(0\le k\le m=\frac{p-1}{2}\) contribute.

For \(0\le k\le m\), using
\[
\binom{p-1-k}{k}\equiv (-1)^k\binom{2k}{k}\pmod p,
\]
we get
\[
\binom{2k}{k}2^k\equiv \binom{p-1-k}{k}(-2)^k\pmod p.
\]
Thus
\[
S\equiv \sum_{k=0}^m k\binom{p-1-k}{k}(-2)^k\pmod p.
\]

Define
\[
P_n(x)=\sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}\binom{n-k}{k}x^k.
\]
Then
\[
S\equiv xP_{p-1}'(x)\Big|_{x=-2}\pmod p.
\]

The polynomials \(P_n\) satisfy
\[
P_n=P_{n-1}+xP_{n-2},\qquad P_0=P_1=1.
\]
Let \(\alpha,\beta\) be the roots of \(t^2-t-x=0\). Then
\[
P_n(x)=\frac{\alpha^{n+1}-\beta^{n+1}}{\alpha-\beta}.
\]
A differentiation gives, for \(\delta=\alpha-\beta\),
\[
xP_n'(x)\equiv \frac{x}{\delta^2}\left((n+1)(\alpha^n+\beta^n)-\frac{2(\alpha^{n+1}-\beta^{n+1})}{\delta}\right).
\]
Here \(n=p-1\), so \(n+1=p\equiv0\). At \(x=-2\), we have \(\delta^2=1+4x=-7\), hence
\[
S\equiv -\frac47\cdot\frac{\alpha^p-\beta^p}{\delta}\pmod p.
\]

Let \(\varepsilon=\left(\frac{-7}{p}\right)\). Since \(\delta^2=-7\), Frobenius gives \(\delta^p=\varepsilon\delta\), and therefore
\[
\frac{\alpha^p-\beta^p}{\delta}=\varepsilon.
\]
So
\[
S\equiv -\frac47\left(\frac{-7}{p}\right)\pmod p.
\]

Now compute the Legendre symbol. Since \(2027\equiv 3\pmod4\) and \(2027\equiv4\pmod7\),
\[
\left(\frac{-7}{2027}\right)=\left(\frac{-1}{2027}\right)\left(\frac{7}{2027}\right)=(-1)(-1)=1.
\]
Therefore
\[
S\equiv -\frac47\pmod{2027}.
\]
Since \(7\cdot 289=2023\equiv -4\pmod{2027}\),
\[
-\frac47\equiv 289\pmod{2027}.
\]

\[
\boxed{289}
\]
